metadata.title: Conway's thrackle conjecture: a new upper bound of $\frac43n$
metadata.abstract: A thrackle is a drawing of a graph in the plane in which every pair of edges meets exactly once, either at a common endpoint or at a proper crossing. Conway conjectured that every thrackle has at most as many edges as vertices. We prove that every thrackle on $n\ge4$ vertices has at most $\left\lfloor4(n-1)/3\right\rfloor$ edges. The proof combines Pammer's computer-assisted verification of the conjecture for graphs on at most twelve vertices with a discharging argument in suitable plane and projective-plane embeddings.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 研究平面 thrackle 图的边数，即每两条边恰好相遇一次的图画。
analysis.breakthrough: 对 n≥4 证明边数至多 floor(4(n−1)/3)，结合最多十二个顶点的既有计算辅助验证与结构放电论证。
analysis.limitations: 仍弱于 Conway 猜想的边数≤顶点数，不能称为解决该猜想；证明使用既有有限计算结果作为输入。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT GPT-6.1-Sol 协助证明发展、引用查找核验、图文准备及独立计算复核；第 2 页明确提及 AI agent 复查既有有限规模计算，未声称主放电思想完全由 AI 提出。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.31589v1 · PDF 第 2 页计算说明与第 6 页 Declaration of AI assistance

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT GPT-6.1-Sol 协助证明发展、引用查找核验、图文准备及独立计算复核；第 2 页明确提及 AI agent 复查既有有限规模计算，未声称主放电思想完全由 AI 提出。

analysis.priorityReason: 对知名图画猜想给出明确的全规模改进上界。
